description: CLK2 (carrier about 145 MHz, 3rd harmonic wanted) through a 27-33-27 ohm T pad at the output, 12 cm of pigtail, an unidentified SAW filter and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (25.8 dB at 435 MHz)

chain.name: 27-33-27 ohm T pad at the Si5351 output
chain.notes: fitted directly at the CLK2 output to stop reflections from the cable and SAW reaching the Si5351; loses 9.9 dB at 435 MHz (15 dB at 145 MHz). Placed BEFORE the pigtail and the SAW, so it is not part of pad_db: the levels in the results are those leaving the SAW, as in the baseline, with the T pad's loss included in them.

chain.name: 12 cm pigtail between the T pad and the SAW
chain.notes: the same pigtail as used on 2m and 6m; type not recorded

chain.name: SAW filter
chain.notes: wide passband, about 421-444 MHz at -3 dB (measured 2026-10-31)

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz

notes: Compare with 70cm-saw-unknown-10dB (SAW directly on the board) and 70cm-saw-unknown-tpad-10dB-12cm-pigtail (pigtail, T pad after the SAW). The T pad is before the SAW here, which took the 6-10 dB pigtail dependence out of the level (measured 2026-11-01). pad_db is 25.8, so levels are 'leaving the SAW' as in the baseline, with the T pad's 9.9 dB (plus the SAW's insertion loss of about 2.5 dB) included in the loss: they read 12 dB lower than a source-side figure.
